scope: Documented generation configuration, retained code snapshots, prompt consistency, and output identity; not a reconstruction of all raw API responses.

generation_protocol.retry_trigger: API exception or no RDKit-valid SMILES extractable from the final response
generation_protocol.final_selection: First RDKit-valid tagged or fallback SMILES extracted from the final assistant response
generation_protocol.runtime_note: Saved logs use eight generation workers for the earlier RC runs and six for the extension. This is a scheduling difference, not evidence of identical execution in every detail.

record_identity.normalization: Sort tuples (group, chemblid, position_label, stripped input SMILES), then JSON encode with ensure_ascii=false and separators=(',', ':').

batch_provenance.note: These phases describe sample expansion, not additional independent copies of the same target-strategy-position. Existing record-level source_phase values remain unchanged.

experiment_guide.role: Experiment notes documenting the RC25 configuration; unsupported legacy docking interpretations in that document are not adopted.

caller_snapshot.role: Archived caller defaults and request construction; source contents and credentials are not copied into this record.

parallel_runner_snapshot.role: Generation, final-response extraction, retry, checkpoint and output rules.

RC_expansion_launcher.role: Model-setting default and common generator invocation with five positions and resume.

prompt_expansion_builder.role: Preserves earlier target prompts and imports the same TG/PG guidance builders for new targets.

checkpoint_preload.role: Links earlier records to expanded output files without regeneration.

NG_launcher_log.role: Records requested deepseek-v4-flash and low reasoning for the source NG run; this is a launcher record, not a raw server-response archive.
